faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium VCR Female Nut suitable for VCR female nut coupling for UHV gas lines?
faq.a: Titanium VCR Female Nut uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address gas delivery operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium VCR Female Nut?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium VCR Female Nut is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for vcr female nut requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium VCR Female Nut require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. vcr female nut components require Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for vcr female nut application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.
